pages.title: Photonic Lens
pages.text: A lithography lens made of Cherenkov quartz shaped by metamaterial. It focuses light onto wafers with near-perfect precision and is never consumed; it can focus forever. Its centre glows faint blue and the edges bend light the wrong way.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Engraving wafers needed a lens finer than any glass. Shaping a Block of Cherenkov Quartz with a Metamaterial Sheet by hand, I made one that bent light below the diffraction limit.

Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Geometric Optics.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): CPT Mirror, Coherent Wiring Harness, Dimensional Residue, Infrared Spectrometer, Mirror Matter Foundry, Quantum Lithographer, Tesseract Lens.
